You are a professional character designer for noir thriller fiction. Create a vivid, believable character profile for a protagonist based on this concept:

"a retired detective haunted by an unsolved case"

Return a JSON object with exactly these keys:
  "name"               — full character name (string)
  "age"                — age in years (integer)
  "background"         — 2-3 sentence backstory (string)
  "personality_traits" — array of 3-5 trait strings
  "goals"              — array of 1-3 goal strings
  "flaws"              — array of 1-3 flaw strings
  "relationships"      — array of strings describing key relationships (can be empty)

Output only the JSON object, no markdown fences, no extra text.
